value.displayName: reset 数值与空状态标题
value.purpose: 账户右侧 reset 次数及空状态标题。

label.purpose: 账户方案、提示和控件说明；局部 medium 或 semibold。

caption.purpose: reset 标签、重置时间和更新时间。

ring-number.purpose: 基础起始字号；按直径缩放，再自适应缩小以适配环内空间。使用 NSFont.monospacedDigitSystemFont；仅显示数字或未知符号，不带 %。

motion.name: popover-animation
motion.purpose: 展开与收起使用系统原生过渡，每次操作读取 Reduce Motion；切换账户重新定位已显示的面板。圆环无持续动画，同步期间仅显示系统 ProgressView。

native.extraction: Inspection of native Swift sources, current direction contract and independent v3 finish review of six native offscreen renders; no web detector ran.

ringGeometry.numberFit: Start at typography.ring-number × scale; shrink by 0.2pt × scale until the text diagonal fits 2 × holeRadius - 0.5pt × scale, with a 4pt × scale loop bound.
ringGeometry.centerContent: Rounded outer remaining number without %; unknown is —. Detail rows, tooltips and accessibility labels retain percentage semantics.

layout.panelAccountResets: includesResets: false; count displayed as adjacent text

components.name: Account ring
components.behavior: Outer long window + inner 5-hour window when both exist; thicker single ring otherwise. Center shows outer remaining number without %. Each available reset is one adjacent thin stroke.

components.name: Account row
components.behavior: Select account to reveal actual window rows; reset count appears on the right.

components.name: Connection buttons
components.behavior: Disabled while connecting or awaiting login.

components.name: Account name
components.behavior: Up to 32 characters; native focus and editing feedback.

components.name: Panel auto-hide
components.behavior: First settings section. Enabled by default with a 3-second delay, configurable from 1 to 300 seconds or off; preferences persist. Returning to the panel or focusing a text field cancels the countdown.

components.name: Login at launch
components.behavior: No automatic registration; actual system status is refreshed. Pending approval keeps the request switch on and explicitly says automatic launch is not enabled. Changes disable the switch; errors are visible.

components.name: Quota detail
components.behavior: Named actual windows, remaining percentages, reset times and used percentages; no window selector.

evidence.disposition: ship — limited to static native presentation and source inspection
evidence.tests: 25 tests passed in the parent implementation run; not repeated during documentation.
evidence.revisionBasis: User desktop screenshots showed v2 rings were oversized; v3 reduces ring size and strokes.
evidence.desktopAttempt: CUA timed out during this turn; offscreen renders do not certify desktop interaction.

native.previewPolicy: No HTML/CSS facsimiles or synthetic tonal ramps: native controls and dynamic system colors remain authoritative. Native components and offscreen evidence are recorded here; the web snippet array is intentionally empty.

autoHide.persistence: Settings.autoHideEnabled and Settings.autoHideDelaySeconds; missing fields decode to defaults.
autoHide.scheduling: Event driven, at most one one-shot Timer; only while visible, pointer outside, text editing inactive and auto-hide enabled.
autoHide.cancellation: Pointer return, editing focus, disabling and closing cancel pending work. Ending editing outside the panel starts the full delay. Generation checks reject stale callbacks.
autoHide.desktopEvidence: Actual hover/focus event integration and perceived delay remain unverified because the CUA attempt timed out.

narrative.overview:
每个已连接账户对应一个细绿色圆环入口，环内以不带 `%` 的数字显示剩余百分比；额度周期、重置时间和账户设置在原生弹出面板中呈现。界面使用系统字体、SF Symbols 和 macOS 控件，保持紧凑、清楚、低干扰。

这是 v0.3 当前实现的记录，主要依据 `Sources/CodexUsageRings/Views.swift`、`RingRenderer.swift`、`Application.swift`、`PanelAutoHide.swift`、`LoginAtLaunch.swift` 与 `Sources/UsageCore/Models.swift`。尺寸均为 macOS 逻辑点，前置 token 不代表网页 CSS 配置；系统动态色、材质和控件外观继续由原生 API 决定。无演示模式，也不提供置顶或额度周期切换控件。
keyCharacteristics: 一账户一入口：两种额度使用外长内短的同心环，单窗口使用较厚单环。
中心数字显示外环剩余额度且不带 `%`，右侧每条细竖线代表一次可用 banked reset。
系统材质、系统字体和原生表单控件支持明暗外观。
面板支持可配置的鼠标移出自动收起；原生展开收起遵循减少动态效果，无持续动画。

rules.name: The Remaining Rule
rules.body: 弧长和额度条长度都表示剩余额度；中心数字取外环窗口，详情文字明确该窗口名称。

dos: **Do** 保持一账户一入口，按真实窗口使用外长内短双环或较厚单环。
**Do** 让中心数字与外环一致，省略环内 `%`，并逐条显示实际可用 reset。
**Do** 用文字绿承载小字号绿色文字，并在明暗外观检查可读性。
**Do** 保留系统控件、键盘焦点和辅助标签，让 macOS 管理原生反馈。
**Do** 在原生展开收起时尊重 Reduce Motion，并在移回或编辑时取消自动收起计时。
**Do** 用文字区分未知、过期、等待批准和真实已同步状态。
donts: **Don't** 恢复演示、置顶或额度周期切换控件。
**Don't** 为缺失窗口或未知 reset 数量生成推测的环或竖线。
**Don't** 为原生材质、系统动态色或系统圆角杜撰固定 CSS token。
**Don't** 加入持续动画或绕过既有低耗电刷新节奏。
**Don't** 将离屏 QA 渲染宣称为实际桌面截图、点击验证或电池续航证据。
